newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK EXTENDS TAURAS DEBT REPAYMENT TERM.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK EXTENDS TAURAS DEBT REPAYMENT TERM.

text.p: The board of the Bank of Lithuania decided on Thursday to extend Tauras Bank's term for repaying a 13.7 million litas loan made to help it overcome liquidity problems to June 19.
The central bank, in a statement, said Tauras Bank had mortgaged its property as collateral for the loan.
"The board took this decision taking into account the efforts of Tauras Bank to distribute a new 40 million litas share issue...to solve its liquidity problems," the bank said.
But local analysts have voiced doubts on the likely success of a new share issue.
The bank's share capital at the end of April was 36 million litas, assets were 187.2 million litas, deposits and letters of credit 126.2 million litas and loans were 115.5 million litas.
The bank posted 10.6 million litas net profit in 1996 but has not revealed its first quarter figures.
